claims.claim: 部分蔬菜可以再次种植来获得种子（例如芜菁的留种机制）
claims.evidence: 3 Turnip seeds can be obtained by planting and growing a 'Seed-turnip' using the Cultivator.

claims.claim: 大麦（Barley）只能在平原（Plains）区域种植
claims.evidence: Barley can only be planted and harvested in the Plains biome, using a Cultivator.

claims.claim: 作物不长可能是区域错误、空间不足或缺乏阳光（一般性种植机制）
claims.evidence: Crops will not grow if any of the three conditions are met: Wrong biome / Not enough space / Not enough sunlight.

claims.claim: 不同植物对空间和区域的要求不完全相同
claims.evidence: Some crops can only be planted in certain biome requirements... Most crops require a 1x1 area of free space around them.

notes: 区域限制（大麦=平原）与留种机制（芜菁）均逐字对应 fandom，正文准确，无需修改。
